```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
```

## Results

Four floats, each a different cell of the precedence matrix, reached through
`apa_quarto_markdown_block()` directly, one layer below the public entry
point `apa.quarto.docx()` (Task 8, D30) that now dispatches to it -- kept at
this layer deliberately so a change to the dispatcher (the mismatch message,
the LaTeX/markdown routing) cannot mask a regression in the precedence
mechanism itself. THREE of the four deliberately set neither `tbl-cap` nor
`apa-note`, or only one of the two -- every other fixture in this suite sets
both (see test-title-note-defaults.R's own banner comment), which is exactly
the coverage trap this file exists to avoid.

`tbl-auto`: nothing set at all -- generated title AND generated note.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-auto
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:3]))
```

`tbl-capmixed`: `tbl-cap` only, no `apa-note` -- the author's own title with
the GENERATED note. This is the author's primary real-world case: an own
title paired with an automatically generated note.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-capmixed
#| tbl-cap: "Capmixed Author Wrote This Title"
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.reg.table(
  stats::lm(rating ~ complaints, data = attitude)))
```

`tbl-argmixed`: no `tbl-cap`, a `title` R argument instead -- the argument
title with the GENERATED note.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-argmixed
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 2:4]),
  title = "Argmixed Title From The Argument")
```

`tbl-both`: `tbl-cap` AND `apa-note` both set, AND `title =`/`note =`
arguments supplied too -- the chunk options must win over the arguments AND
over the generated values, both ways round.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-both
#| tbl-cap: "Chunkboth Title Wins"
#| apa-note: "Chunknoteboth wins over the argument."
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 3:5]),
  title = "Argboth Title Loses", note = "Argnoteboth loses.")
```

ENDMARKER closes the body of this manuscript, after every table.
